name: End card with logo, tagline and clicked link button
description: Closing brand card on the clean background: a rounded orange logo square with a white icon and a soft orange glow, the brand name in big condensed letters, a tagline with one word in orange, then a black rounded link button ('example.com →') that a mouse pointer glides to and clicks, with a small grey line of fine print underneath.
use_when: The last line of the video: the call to action, 'try it out', 'link in bio', 'book a call', 'go to example.com', or a sign-off with the product name.

split_at.help: characters of the brand shown in ink; the rest is orange (e.g. 5 for 'PUNCHEDIT'). Empty = colour the last word, or all ink for one word

tagline.help: one short line under the name, e.g. 'Save time in editing.'

highlight.help: the word (or words) of the tagline to colour orange, e.g. 'time'

url.help: text on the button, e.g. 'example.com'; empty = no button and no click

small.help: fine print under the button, e.g. 'Book a call · first video free'

icon.help: GFX icon name inside the logo mark
